input.title: Invalid cursor after indent and note
input.body:
## Steps to Reproduce

```
- a
- b
  - =note
    - c
```

1. Set the cursor on `b`
2. Indent
3. Activate the Note command (Meta + Option + n)

## Current Behavior

Cursor is set to invalid Path `['b']`.

## Expected Behavior

Cursor should be set to correct Path `['a', 'b']`.

## Testing

Add a unit test.
